request.text:
Ticket (personal data masked):
I need admin to install Figma plugins.

Employee: Product Designer, Design, New York; MacBook Pro 14-inch (macOS 15).

Why the automated desk stopped: Decide did not clear it for self-service (escalate is 100% likely).

What the automated desk already did: screened the ticket and cut an injected instruction; classified it as software, low severity; searched the knowledge base and kept 2 passages; drafted a reply and verified it (99% grounded).

Verified holding reply sent to the employee:
The help desk does not grant local administrator or Domain Admin rights.
1. Most software can be installed from the software portal without admin rights.
2. If you need something that is not in the portal, raise a software request with the name, version and business reason
